mapper.select: SELECT crosscheck.trans_id AS transId, ocr.front_image AS image1, crosscheck.selfie_img AS image2, crosscheck.result_code AS result, crosscheck.fr_score AS score, crosscheck.fr_threshold AS threshold FROM tbl_crosscheck_data crosscheck INNER JOIN tbl_ocr_data ocr ON crosscheck.trans_id = ocr.trans_id WHERE crosscheck.trans_id = #{transId} AND crosscheck.is_latest = 'Y' LIMIT 1
